title: Parental leave: company policy
text: Meridian Works offers 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to the primary caregiver and 4 weeks to the secondary caregiver. Employees are eligible after 6 months of continuous employment. Leave can be taken in up to three blocks within the first year after birth or adoption. Requests go through Workday at least 8 weeks before the planned start.

title: Parental leave: Germany supplement
text: Employees in the Germany office are covered by statutory Elternzeit (up to 36 months of job-protected leave) and Elterngeld paid by the state. On top of the statutory benefit, Meridian Works pays the difference between Elterngeld and full salary for the first 12 weeks. The company's 16-week paid policy applies in parallel; the longer of the two entitlements is used.

title: Parental leave: United Kingdom supplement
text: Employees in the UK office are entitled to statutory maternity, paternity and shared parental leave. Meridian Works enhances statutory pay to 20 weeks at full salary for the primary caregiver and 4 weeks at full salary for the secondary caregiver. Eligibility follows the UK statutory rules (26 weeks of service by the 15th week before the expected week of childbirth).

title: Contractors and leave benefits
text: Independent contractors and agency workers are engaged under a services agreement and are not employees. They are not eligible for Meridian Works parental leave, enhanced pay, or paid annual leave. Contractors in Germany and the UK keep any statutory rights that attach to their own employer or umbrella company. Engagement managers must not promise leave benefits to contractors; questions go to the Contracts team.

title: Annual leave: company policy
text: Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, plus public holidays for their office location. Leave accrues monthly. Up to 5 unused days can be carried into the next year and must be used by 31 March.

title: Urlaub: Zusatz für den Standort Deutschland
text: Mitarbeitende am Standort Deutschland erhalten 30 Tage bezahlten Jahresurlaub, zuzüglich der gesetzlichen Feiertage des Bundeslandes. Der Urlaub wird monatlich angesammelt. Bis zu 10 nicht genommene Tage können in das Folgejahr übertragen werden und müssen bis zum 31. März genommen werden. Urlaubsanträge werden in Workday gestellt und vom Vorgesetzten genehmigt.

title: Annual leave: United Kingdom supplement
text: Employees in the UK office receive 25 days of paid annual leave plus the 8 UK bank holidays, for 33 days in total. Part-time employees receive a pro-rated amount. Up to 5 days can be carried over. UK employees may also buy up to 5 extra days each year during the November benefits window.

title: Contractor time off
text: Contractors do not accrue annual leave and are not paid for days not worked. Planned time off is agreed in writing with the engagement manager at least two weeks in advance. Contractors invoice only for days delivered. Extended absences of more than 10 working days require a change order to the services agreement.

title: Expenses and travel
text: Business travel is booked through the Navan portal. Economy class applies to flights under 6 hours. Meals are reimbursed up to 60 EUR or 50 GBP per day with receipts. Expense reports are due within 30 days of the trip.

title: Trabajo remoto: política de la empresa
text: Los empleados de Meridian Works pueden trabajar de forma remota hasta tres días por semana con la aprobación de su responsable. El trabajo desde otro país está limitado a 20 días laborables al año y debe aprobarse con el equipo de Personas con cuatro semanas de antelación. El equipo proporciona un portátil y una silla ergonómica para el espacio de trabajo en casa.

title: Sick leave
text: Employees receive full pay for up to 10 sick days per year, then statutory sick pay for their location. Absences longer than 3 consecutive days need a doctor's note. Germany: statutory continued pay for 6 weeks applies. UK: Statutory Sick Pay applies after the company-paid period.

title: Performance reviews
text: Performance reviews happen twice a year, in June and December. Managers write the review in Lattice; employees add a self-assessment. Contractors are not reviewed in Lattice; their work is assessed at each change order.
